title: Ours didn't hold up well
text: Ours didn't hold up well. After 2 months this cup started falling apart. My son bought this for his step dad. This was used every morning and we ended up tossing it out.

product_metadata.title: Copco Big Joe Thermal Travel Mug with Contoured Handle, 24-Ounce, Steel
features: Details on the Copco Thermal Travel Mug are what make it a top choice for people on the go
Holds a whopping 24 ounces, yet its tapering design leaves the base slim enough to fit in standard car cup holders
A non-skid base prevents tipping and a tight fitting lid prevents big spills
The contoured handle works for right or left handers
Hand washing is recommended for best care
